Name: unofficial TMX conversion for Refugee NPCs
Author: Tarniyar
Description:
Just to be clear -- I'm not picking up the Refugee's mod -- I just wanted to get it functional again.  So please don't send me other bugs reports or fix requests for the mod. :P

This mod is [i]only[/i] the TMX content pack (and some other minor patches), not the full Refugees mod!

Now compatible with SVE!

[size=3][b]To install:[/b][/size]

Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL Map Toolkit[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed.
Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3204]Refugee NPCs mod[/url].
Open the Refugee NPCs folder and delete the "[ALL] Refugee NPCs" folder.
Download and unzip this mod "Unofficial Refugees.zip" and copy those two folders into the Refugee NPCs folder.
You need to [i]overwrite[/i] the file "[CP] Refugee NPCs/content.json" with my new version or it won't work with SVE.

And done!  Have fun.  And if anyone wants to pick up the Refugee mod, feel free to use my work.

Many many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url] for help in figuring out how to make the SVE workaround.
